story: In the year 2157, humanity has expanded across the stars, establishing colonies and thriving amidst the vastness of space. But this golden age of exploration was not destined to last. In the shadowed edges of the galaxy, an ancient and forgotten enemy, the Bydo, began to stir. Created centuries ago as living weapons of war, the Bydo were banished to the void after a devastating conflict. Thought to be eradicated, they have now returned, stronger and more determined than ever to annihilate all sentient life. The first strike came without warning. A Federation outpost, Helios Prime, was obliterated in an instant. Survivors reported massive biomechanical ships, unlike anything seen before, ripping through their defenses. The Bydo left only a cryptic message: 'Assimilation is inevitable.' The Interstellar Federation scrambled to respond, deploying its most advanced fleet. But the Bydo overwhelmed every counterattack, spreading chaos and destruction as they moved deeper into human territory. Faced with mounting losses, the Federation turned to a desperate solution: the R-90 Phoenix, an experimental starfighter equipped with the revolutionary Force Orb system. You, a pilot of the elite Nova Wing squadron, have been chosen to lead the charge. Your mission: infiltrate Bydo-controlled space, uncover their plans, and destroy their central core before they reach Earth. As you launch into the cold expanse, the stakes couldn't be higher. The fate of humanity rests on your shoulders. The Bydo are relentless, adaptive, and driven by an insidious purpose. Will you have the strength and skill to turn the tide? Or will humanity fall to the abyss?
